kind: Supplementary browser demonstration, automated with Playwright; not a rerun of the historical test matrix.

source.method: All 82 assessed source/config/test hashes matched before and after capture. The unchanged application was rebuilt locally and launched from its built API and production web bundle; no Git checkout or application edit.

runtime.postgresql: PostgreSQL 17.11 on x86_64-windows, compiled by msvc-19.44.35228, 64-bit
runtime.configuration: Documented local HTTP demo profile; fresh generated isolated environment, not existing private demo files. Dynamic loopback ports; no populated demo/development database reused.

databaseSafety.setup: Explicit ALLOW_TEST_DATABASE and SEED_SYNTHETIC_DATA for the new test database; distinct unused development reference.
databaseSafety.cleanup: Browser and temporary API/preview processes stopped; only the task-owned temporary cluster stopped in finally.

captures.precondition: Fresh browser and newly seeded isolated database; unauthenticated.
captures.expected: Login form, empty password and no private workspace.
captures.actual: Login form enabled; password empty; private workspace absent.

captures.precondition: Guest form with locally generated synthetic owner credentials.
captures.expected: 200 login and trusted OWNER identity; owner workspace visible.
captures.actual: Login 200, current identity 200/OWNER, owner workspace visible; no password field remains.

captures.action: Click Log out; wait for the actual server response.
captures.expected: 204 and guest Login form; private workspace absent.
captures.actual: Logout 204, enabled Login form, empty password and no private workspace.

captures.precondition: Actual logout has returned 204; guest session only.
captures.actual: Real API response 401 AUTH_REQUIRED; browser displays the safe error JSON.

limits: One owner normal login/logout sequence at 360px; this is selected demonstration evidence for E01/E02, not full STS execution, all roles/widths, expiry/replay or failure-permutation certification. No credentials, raw session cookies or CSRF tokens recorded.
